requirements.text: The rear lamp (ESA) shall be tested for the starting profile according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
requirements.quote: Starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.

requirements.text: The rear lamp (ESA) shall have Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.
requirements.quote: Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.

requirements.text: The rear lamp (ESA) shall meet the limits throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.quote: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).

requirements.text: If peak detectors are used, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied to the measurements of the rear lamp.
requirements.quote: If peak detectors are used a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied.

requirements.text: The measurements of the rear lamp shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver, using the parameters defined in Table 1 and Table 2.
requirements.quote: The measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver. The parameters to be used are defined in Table 1 and Table 2.

requirements.text: FFT-based measuring instruments shall continuously record and evaluate the signal during the measurement time.
requirements.quote: FFT-based measuring instruments shall continuously record and evaluate the signal during the measurement time.

requirements.text: If FFT-based instruments are used, the minimum measurement time shall be 1 s per analysis frequency band (in real-time mode) of the FFT instrument.
requirements.quote: If using FFT-based instruments, the minimum measurement time shall be 1 s per analysis frequency band (in real-time mode) of the FFT instrument.

requirements.text: If a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements, the video bandwidth shall be at least three times the resolution bandwidth (RBW).
requirements.quote: Note: If a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements, the video bandwidth shall be at least three times the resolution bandwidth (RBW).

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, the configuration of the rear lamp with the LV harness closer to the antenna shall be tested.
requirements.quote: Unless otherwise specified the configuration with the LV harness closer to the antenna shall be tested.

requirements.text: The phase centre of the antenna shall be in line with the centre of the longitudinal part of the wiring harnesses of the rear lamp for frequencies up to 1,000 MHz.
requirements.quote: The phase centre of the antenna shall be in line with the centre of the longitudinal part of the wiring harnesses for frequencies up to 1,000 MHz.

requirements.text: The Technical Service shall perform the test on the rear lamp at the intervals specified in the CISPR 12 standard throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz.
requirements.quote: The Technical Service shall perform the test at the intervals specified in the CISPR 12 standard throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz.

requirements.text: If the limit is exceeded during the test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the rear lamp (ESA) and not to background radiation.
requirements.quote: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA and not to background radiation.

requirements.text: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarization) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading of the rear lamp at the frequency at which the measurements were made.
requirements.quote: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarization) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading at the frequency at which the measurements were made.

requirements.text: During the radiated narrowband electromagnetic emission measurement, the rear lamp under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.quote: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.

requirements.text: The radiated narrowband electromagnetic emission test of the rear lamp shall be performed according to ALSE method described in paragraph 6.4. of CISPR 25.
requirements.quote: The test shall be performed according to ALSE method described in paragraph 6.4. of CISPR 25.

requirements.text: To ensure that there is no extraneous noise or signal of a magnitude sufficient to affect materially the measurement, ambient measurements shall be taken before or after the main test of the rear lamp.
requirements.quote: Ambient To ensure that there is no extraneous noise or signal of a magnitude sufficient to affect materially the measurement; measurements shall be taken before or after the main test.

requirements.text: During the ambient measurement, the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation, except for intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.
requirements.quote: In this measurement, the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation, except for intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.

requirements.text: The limits shall apply to the rear lamp throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.quote: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).

requirements.text: Measurements of the rear lamp shall be performed with an average detector.
requirements.quote: Measurements shall be performed with an average detector.

requirements.text: The measurements of the rear lamp shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver.
requirements.quote: The measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver.

requirements.text: The parameters used for the rear lamp measurements shall be those defined in Tables 1 and 2.
requirements.quote: The parameters to be used are defined in Tables 1 and 2.

requirements.text: For the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz with a spectrum analyser (Table 1), the average detector RBW at -3 dB shall be 100/120 kHz and the minimum scan time shall be 100 ms/MHz.
requirements.quote: Table 1 Spectrum analyser parameters Frequency range MHz Average detector RBW at -3 dB Minimum scan time 30 to 1,000 100/120 kHz 100 ms/MHz

requirements.text: If a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements, the video band width shall be at least three times the resolution band width (RBW).
requirements.quote: Note: If a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements, the video band width shall be at least three times the resolution band width (RBW)

requirements.text: For the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz with a scanning receiver (Table 2), the average detector BW at -6 dB shall be 120 kHz, the maximum step size shall be 60 kHz and the minimum dwell time shall be 5 ms.
requirements.quote: Table 2 Scanning receiver parameters Frequency range MHz Average detector BW at -6 dB Maximum step size Minimum dwell time 30 to 1,000 120 kHz 60 kHz 5 ms

requirements.text: The Technical Service shall perform the test of the rear lamp at the intervals specified in the CISPR 12 standard throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz, except that if the manufacturer provides measurement data for the whole frequency band from a test laboratory accredited to the applicable parts of ISO 17025 and recognized by the Type Approval Authority, the Technical Service may divide the frequency range in 14 frequency bands 30-34, 34-45, 45-60, 60-80, 80-100, 100-130, 130-170, 170-225, 225-300, 300-400, 400-525, 525-700, 700-850 and 850-1,000 MHz and perform tests at the 14 frequencies giving the highest emission levels within each band to confirm that the rear lamp meets the requirements of this Annex.
requirements.quote: The Technical Service shall perform the test at the intervals specified in the CISPR 12 standard throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz. Alternatively, if the manufacturer provides measurement to data for the whole frequency band from a test laboratory accredited to the applicable parts of ISO 17025 and recognized by the Type Approval Authority, the Technical Service may divide the frequency range in 14 frequency bands

requirements.text: If the limit is exceeded during the test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the rear lamp and not to background radiation including broadband radiation from the rear lamp.
requirements.quote: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA and not to background radiation including broadband radiation from the ESA.

requirements.text: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarisation) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading at the frequency at which the measurements were made.
requirements.quote: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarisation) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading at the frequency at which the measurements were made.

requirements.text: The rear lamp shall comply with the requirements of any combination of the following test methods at the manufacturer's discretion, provided that the results cover the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex: (a) Absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2; (b) TEM cell testing according to ISO 11452-3; (c) Bulk current injection testing according to ISO 11452-4; (d) Stripline testing according to ISO 11452-5; (e) Reverberation chamber test according to ISO 11452-11.
requirements.quote: ESAs may comply with the requirements of any combination of the following test methods at the manufacturer's discretion provided that these results in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered

requirements.text: Where the rear lamp is in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid", the rear lamp shall comply with the requirements of the combination of the Absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2 and Bulk current injection testing according to ISO 11452-4 at the manufacturer's discretion, provided that the results cover the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex.
requirements.quote: ESAs in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" shall comply with the requirements of the combination of the Absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2 and Bulk current injection testing according to ISO 11452-4 at the manufacturer's discretion provided that these results in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered.

requirements.text: The test conditions for the rear lamp immunity test shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.quote: The test conditions shall be according to ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: During the immunity tests, the rear lamp under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
requirements.quote: The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.

requirements.text: During the immunity tests, the rear lamp shall be arranged as defined in this Annex unless individual test methods dictate otherwise.
requirements.quote: It shall be arranged as defined in this Annex unless individual test methods dictate otherwise.

requirements.text: Measurements on the rear lamp shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.quote: Measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range.
requirements.quote: (a) AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range;

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range.
requirements.quote: (b) PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range;

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges.
requirements.quote: (c) PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges.

requirements.text: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and the rear lamp manufacturer, the frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.quote: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer. Frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: The bulk current injection test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench using the BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA, or using the BCI test method with closed loop method and injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA.
requirements.quote: The test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench with the following characteristics: BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA;Or BCI test method with closed loop method and injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA.

requirements.text: Where the ESA is tested while installed in the vehicle as an alternative, the bulk current injection test shall be performed according to ISO 11451-4 using the BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.
requirements.quote: As an alternative the ESA may be tested while installed in the vehicle according to ISO 11451-4 with the following characteristics: BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.

requirements.text: The transient test method shall ensure the immunity of ESAs to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply.
requirements.quote: This test method shall ensure the immunity of ESAs to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply and limit conducted transients from ESAs to the vehicle power supply.

requirements.text: The transient test method shall limit conducted transients from ESAs to the vehicle power supply.
requirements.quote: This test method shall ensure the immunity of ESAs to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply and limit conducted transients from ESAs to the vehicle power supply.

requirements.text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.quote: Apply the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.

requirements.text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines, except that ESAs that are exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to starting profile.
requirements.quote: Apply the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines. ESAs that are exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to starting profile.

requirements.text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by ESAs on 12/24 V supply lines shall be measured according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as on other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.quote: Measurement according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.

requirements.text: The Technical Service shall perform the test as specified in paragraph 7.16.2.1. of this Regulation, except that if the manufacturer provides measurement from a test laboratory accredited to the applicable parts of ISO 17025 and recognized by the Type Approval Authority, the Technical Service may choose not to perform the test to confirm that the ESA meets the requirements of this Annex.
requirements.quote: The Technical Service shall perform the test as specified in paragraph 7.16.2.1. of this Regulation. Alternatively, if the manufacturer provides measurement from a test laboratory accredited to the applicable parts of ISO 17025 and recognized by the Type Approval Authority, the Technical Service may choose not to perform the test to confirm that the ESA meets the requirements of this Annex.

requirements.text: The immunity test shall be conducted in accordance with IEC 461000-4-5.
requirements.quote: Test shall be conducted in accordance with IEC 461000-4-5.

requirements.text: The immunity test shall be performed only at the severity levels given in 7.16.2.1.
requirements.quote: Test shall be performed only at the severity levels given in 7.16.2.1.

requirements.text: The LED light sources submitted for approval shall bear on the cap the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.quote: LED light sources submitted for approval shall bear on the cap: 2.3.1.1. the trade name or mark of the applicant;

requirements.text: The LED light sources submitted for approval shall bear on the cap the rated voltage.
requirements.quote: 2.3.1.2. the rated voltage;

requirements.text: The LED light sources submitted for approval shall bear on the cap the designation of the relevant category.
requirements.quote: 2.3.1.3. the designation of the relevant category;

requirements.text: The LED light sources submitted for approval shall bear on the cap a space of sufficient size to accommodate the approval mark.
requirements.quote: 2.3.1.4. a space of sufficient size to accommodate the approval mark.

requirements.text: In the case of LED substitute light sources, the LED light sources submitted for approval shall bear on the cap the following symbol: ISO 7000, symbol 1641.
requirements.quote: 2.3.1.5. In the case of LED substitute light sources, the following symbol1: 1ISO 7000, symbol 1641

requirements.text: The marks and inscriptions specified in paragraphs 2.3.1. and 2.4.4. shall be clearly legible and be indelible.
requirements.quote: The marks and inscriptions specified in paragraphs 2.3.1. and 2.4.4. shall be clearly legible and be indelible.

requirements.text: Each sample of the LED light source submitted shall conform to the relevant specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: Each sample submitted shall conform to the relevant specifications of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The LED light sources shall be so designed as to be and to remain in good working order when in normal use.
requirements.quote: LED light sources shall be so designed as to be and to remain in good working order when in normal use.

requirements.text: The LED light sources shall exhibit no fault in design or manufacture.
requirements.quote: They shall moreover exhibit no fault in design or manufacture.

requirements.text: The LED light sources shall exhibit no scores or spots on their optical surfaces which might impair their efficiency and their optical performance.
requirements.quote: LED light sources shall exhibit no scores or spots on their optical surfaces which might impair their efficiency and their optical performance.

requirements.text: When commencing approval testing and when required in the respective paragraphs in this Regulation, the absence of scores or spots on the optical surfaces of the LED light sources shall be verified.
requirements.quote: This shall be verified when commencing approval testing and when required in the respective paragraphs in this Regulation.

requirements.text: The LED light sources shall be equipped with standard caps complying with the cap data sheets of IEC Publication 60061 as specified on the individual data sheets of Annex 1.
requirements.quote: LED light sources shall be equipped with standard caps complying with the cap data sheets of IEC Publication 60061 as specified on the individual data sheets of Annex 1.

requirements.text: The cap shall be strong and firmly secured to the rest of the LED light source.
requirements.quote: The cap shall be strong and firmly secured to the rest of the LED light source.

requirements.text: To ascertain whether LED light sources conform to the requirements of paragraphs 3.2.3. to 3.2.5. above, a visual inspection, a dimension check and, where necessary, a trial fitting into the holder as specified in IEC publication 60061 shall be carried out.
requirements.quote: To ascertain whether LED light sources conform to the requirements of paragraphs 3.2.3. to 3.2.5. above, a visual inspection, a dimension check and, where necessary, a trial fitting into the holder as specified in IEC publication 60061 shall be carried out.

requirements.text: The solid state junction(s) and possibly one or more elements for fluorescence-based conversion shall be the only element(s) of the LED light source that generate(s) and emit(s) light when energized.
requirements.quote: The solid state junction(s) and possibly one or more elements for fluorescence-based conversion shall be the only element(s) of the LED light source that generate(s) and emit(s) light when energized.

requirements.text: The LED light sources shall first be aged at their test voltage for at least forty-eight hours.
requirements.quote: LED light sources shall first be aged at their test voltage for at least forty-eight hours.

requirements.text: For multi-function LED light sources, each function shall be aged separately.
requirements.quote: For multi-function LED light sources, each function shall be aged separately.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, electrical and photometric measurements of the LED light source shall be carried out at the relevant test voltage(s).
requirements.quote: Unless otherwise specified, electrical and photometric measurements shall be carried out at the relevant test voltage(s).

requirements.text: The position and dimensions of the light emitting area shall conform to the requirements as given on the relevant data sheet of Annex 1.
requirements.quote: The position and dimensions of the light emitting area shall conform to the requirements as given on the relevant data sheet of Annex 1.

requirements.text: The measurement of the position and dimensions of the light emitting area shall be made after ageing the LED light source according to 3.3.1.
requirements.quote: The measurement shall be made after ageing the LED light source according to 3.3.1.

requirements.text: When measured according to the conditions specified in Annex 4, the luminous flux of the LED light source shall be within the limits given on the relevant data sheet of Annex 1.
requirements.quote: When measured according to the conditions specified in Annex 4, the luminous flux shall be within the limits given on the relevant data sheet of Annex 1.

requirements.text: The measurement of the luminous flux shall be made after ageing the LED light source according to 3.3.1.
requirements.quote: The measurement shall be made after ageing the LED light source according to 3.3.1.

requirements.text: When measured according to the test conditions specified in Annex 4, the normalized luminous intensity distribution and/or cumulative luminous flux distribution of the LED light source shall be within the limits given on the relevant data sheet of annex 1.
requirements.quote: When measured according to the test conditions specified in Annex 4, the normalized luminous intensity distribution and/or cumulative luminous flux distribution shall be within the limits given on the relevant data sheet of annex 1.

requirements.text: The measurement of the normalized luminous intensity distribution and/or cumulative luminous flux distribution shall be made after ageing the LED light source according to 3.3.1.
requirements.quote: The measurement shall be made after ageing the LED light source according to 3.3.1.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the LED light sources shall be specified on the relevant data sheet.
requirements.quote: The colour of the light emitted by the LED light sources shall be specified on the relevant data sheet.

requirements.text: The definitions of the colour of the light emitted given in Regulation No. 48 and its series of amendments in force at the time of application for type approval shall apply to the LED light sources.
requirements.quote: The definitions of the colour of the light emitted given in Regulation No. 48 and its series of amendments in force at the time of application for type approval shall apply to this regulation.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the LED light source shall be measured by the method specified in Annex 4.
requirements.quote: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured by the method specified in Annex 4.

requirements.text: The measured integral value of the chromaticity coordinates of the light emitted by the LED light source shall lie within the required chromaticity area.
requirements.quote: The measured integral value of the chromaticity coordinates shall lie within the required chromaticity area.

requirements.text: In the case of LED light sources emitting white light and for use in forward lighting devices, the colour of the LED light source shall be measured in the same directions as where the luminous intensity distribution is specified in the relevant data sheet, but only where the specified minimum luminous intensity is exceeding 50 cd/klm.
requirements.quote: Moreover, in the case of LED light sources emitting white light and for use in forward lighting devices, the colour shall be measured in the same directions as where the luminous intensity distribution is specified in the relevant data sheet, but only where the specified minimum luminous intensity is exceeding 50 cd/klm.

requirements.text: In the case of LED light sources emitting white light and for use in forward lighting devices, each measured value of the chromaticity coordinates of the LED light source shall lie within a tolerance area of 0.025 units in the x direction and 0.050 units in the y direction, containing the measured integral value.
requirements.quote: Each measured value of the chromaticity coordinates shall lie within a tolerance area of 0.025 units in the x direction and 0.050 units in the y direction, containing the measured integral value.

requirements.text: In the case of LED light sources emitting white light and for use in forward lighting devices, the measured value in the direction of maximum luminous intensity and all measured values for a standard (étalon) LED light source shall also lie within the required chromaticity area for white light.
requirements.quote: The measured value in the direction of maximum luminous intensity and all measured values for a standard (étalon) LED light source shall also lie within the required chromaticity area for white light.

requirements.text: The minimum red content value of the LED light source shall be calculated using intervals of one nanometer.
requirements.quote: This value shall be calculated using intervals of one nanometer.

requirements.text: The UV-radiation value of the LED light source shall be calculated using intervals of one nanometer.
requirements.quote: This value shall be calculated using intervals of one nanometer.

requirements.text: In case a maximum test temperature is specified in the relevant data sheet of Annex 1, when measured according to the conditions specified in Annex 4, paragraph 5, the luminous flux values of the LED light source at elevated temperatures shall be within the limits given in the relevant data sheet of Annex 1.
requirements.quote: When measured according to the conditions specified in Annex 4, paragraph 5: (a) The luminous flux values at elevated temperatures shall be within the limits given in the relevant data sheet of Annex 1;

requirements.text: In case a maximum test temperature is specified in the relevant data sheet of Annex 1, when measured according to the conditions specified in Annex 4, paragraph 5, the colour variation of the LED light source shall not exceed 0.010.
requirements.quote: and (b) The colour variation shall not exceed 0.010.

requirements.text: In case a maximum test temperature is specified in the relevant data sheet of Annex 1, after completion of the measurement procedure as prescribed in paragraph 3.10.1, the LED light source shall be continuously operated during 1000 h at the relevant test voltage(s) and, in case of an integrated heatsink, at an ambient temperature corresponding to the maximum test temperature as specified in the relevant data sheet of Annex I.
requirements.quote: After completion of the measurement procedure as prescribed in paragraph 3.10.1., the LED light source shall be continuously operated during 1000 h at the relevant test voltage(s); and (a) In case of an integrated heatsink at an ambient temperature corresponding to the maximum test temperature as specified in the relevant data sheet of Annex I;

requirements.text: In case a maximum test temperature is specified in the relevant data sheet of Annex 1, after completion of the measurement procedure as prescribed in paragraph 3.10.1, the LED light source shall be continuously operated during 1000 h at the relevant test voltage(s) and, in case of a specified Tb-point, at a Tb-value corresponding to the maximum test temperature as specified in the relevant data sheet of Annex I.
requirements.quote: (b) In case of a specified Tb-point at a Tb-value corresponding to the maximum test temperature as specified in the relevant data sheet of Annex I.

requirements.text: In case a maximum test temperature is specified in the relevant data sheet of Annex 1, after completion of the procedure as prescribed in paragraph 3.10.2, when measured according to the conditions specified in Annex 4, paragraph 5, the luminous flux values of the LED light source at elevated temperatures shall not deviate by more than ± 10 per cent from the corresponding values of the individual sample measured according to paragraph 3.10.1.
requirements.quote: (a) The luminous flux values at elevated temperatures shall not deviate by more than ± 10 per cent from the corresponding values of the individual sample measured according to paragraph 3.10.1.;

requirements.text: In case a maximum test temperature is specified in the relevant data sheet of Annex 1, after completion of the procedure as prescribed in paragraph 3.10.2, when measured according to the conditions specified in Annex 4, paragraph 5, the colour variation of the LED light source shall not deviate from the corresponding values of the individual sample measured according to paragraph 3.10.1. by more than ± 0.010.
requirements.quote: and (b) The colour variation shall not deviate from the corresponding values of the individual sample measured according to paragraph 3.10.1. by more than ± 0.010.

requirements.text: In case a maximum test temperature is specified in the relevant data sheet of Annex 1, after completion of the measurement procedure as prescribed by paragraph 3.10.3, the LED light source shall be verified again against the requirements in 3.2.3.
requirements.quote: After completion of the measurement procedure as prescribed by paragraph 3.10.3., the requirements in 3.2.3. shall be verified again.

requirements.text: The LED substitute light source shall comply with the technical requirements to an electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) as specified by Regulation No. 10 and its series of amendments in force at the time of application for type approval.
requirements.quote: The LED substitute light source shall comply with the technical requirements to an electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) as specified by Regulation No. 10 and its series of amendments in force at the time of application for type approval.

regulations.rationale: R148 approves the rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp. It is the consolidated regulation that replaces R7 and R23. (Device approval. Scope: This Regulation applies to the following light-signalling devices (lamps): • Rear-registration plate illuminating lamps • Direction indicator lamps • Position lamps • Stop lamps • End-outline marker lamps • Reversing lamps • Manoeuvring... Spec terms 12.1, obligation base 12.9.)

The lamp is installed on an M1 vehicle, so R48 is the installation regulation for lighting and light-signalling devices. (Installation regulation. Scope: This Regulation applies to vehicles of categories M, N, and to their trailers (category O) with regard to the installation of lighting and light-signalling devices. Spec terms 30.1, obligation base 36.2.)

The integrated retro-reflector is approved under R150, which consolidates R3. (Device approval. Scope: This Regulation applies to retro-reflective devices as: • Retro-reflectors of the Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB and IVA • Retro-reflective Marking Materials of the Classes C, D, E and F, D/E • Retro-reflective Marking Plates for Heavy and L... Spec terms 3.9, obligation base 3.1.)

The LED modules on a PCB make the lamp an electrical/electronic sub-assembly, so R10 (electromagnetic compatibility) applies. (Electromagnetic compatibility. Scope: This Regulation applies to: Vehicles of categories L, M, N O, T, R and S1 with regard to electromagnetic compatibility; Components and separate technical units intended to be fitted in these vehicles with the limitation given in paragrap... Spec terms 9.3, obligation base 8.0.)

The light sources are LEDs. R128 covers replaceable LED light sources, but LED modules on a PCB are often non-replaceable and approved together with the lamp. I include it because recall matters more than precision. (Light sources. Scope: This Regulation applies to LED light sources shown in Annex 1 and intended for use in approved lamps of power-driven vehicles and of their trailers. Spec terms 8.5, obligation base 9.4.)

R7 has been consolidated into R148, so cite R148 instead. (Device approval. Scope: This Regulation applies to: Front and rear position lamps and stop lamps for vehicles of categories L, M, N, O and T; and, End-outline marker lamps for vehicles of categories M, N, O and T. Consolidated into UN R148. Spec terms 1.5, obligation base 2.1.)

R23 has been consolidated into R148. (Device approval. Scope: This Regulation applies to: (a) Reversing lamps for vehicles of categories M, N, O, and T; (b) Manoeuvring lamps for vehicles of categories M and N. Consolidated into UN R148. Spec terms 1.5, obligation base 1.2.)

R3 has been consolidated into R150. (Device approval. Scope: This Regulation applies to retro-reflecting devices for vehicles of categories L, M, N, O, and T. Consolidated into UN R150. Spec terms 0.4, obligation base 0.0.)

R26 is a vehicle-level regulation on external projections and does not approve the lamp itself. (Vehicle approval. Scope: This Regulation applies to external projections of category M1 vehicles. It does not apply to exterior devices for indirect vision or to the ball of towing devices. The purpose of this Regulation is to reduce the risk or seriousness of b... Spec terms 0.4, obligation base 0.0.)

R37 covers filament light sources, and this lamp uses LEDs. (Light sources. Scope: This Regulation applies to filament light sources and their LED replacement light sources shown in Annex 1 and intended for use in approved lamps of power-driven vehicles and of their trailers. Spec terms 0.4, obligation base 9.4.)

R13H is a braking system regulation. Stop lamp activation is a vehicle braking topic, not a requirement on the lamp. (Vehicle approval. Scope: This Regulation applies to the braking of vehicles of categories M1 and N1. This Regulation does not cover: Spec terms 0.4, obligation base 0.0.)

R149 covers road illumination devices such as headlamps and fog lamps, which this lamp does not include. (Device approval. Scope: This Regulation applies to the following road illumination devices (lamps): • Headlamps emitting a driving-beam and/or an asymmetrical passing-beam for vehicles of categories L, M, N and T • Adaptive front-lighting systems (AFS) for vehi... Spec terms 4.2, obligation base 1.6.)

R43 explicitly excludes glazing for lighting devices. (Installation regulation. Scope: This Regulation applies to: (a) Safety glazing materials intended for installation as windscreens or other panes, or as partitioning, on vehicles of category L with bodywork, M, N, O, and T1; (b) Vehicles of category M, N and O with rega... Spec terms 2.8, obligation base 2.0.)

The lamp has no rear fog lamp, and R38 is superseded. (Device approval. Scope: This Regulation applies to rear fog lamps for vehicles of categories L3, L4, L5, L7, M, N, O, and T1. Consolidated into UN R148. Spec terms 0.7, obligation base 0.3.)

The lamp has no direction indicator, and R6 is superseded by R148. (Device approval. Scope: This Regulation applies to direction indicators for vehicles of categories L, M, N, O, and T. Consolidated into UN R148. Spec terms 0.4, obligation base 0.0.)
